items.title: Buffett remains active at 96, but Berkshire's shares aren't doing much
items.summary: Warren Buffett will be celebrating his 96th birthday on Sunday, but Berkshire Hathaway investors aren't celebrating the stock's anemic performance.

items.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
items.summary: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

items.title: Las Vegas Sands shares are about to 'catch a heater,' says Mike Khouw
items.summary: Although named after the Nevada gaming mecca, Las Vegas Sands has largely depended on the Asia/Macau story of the last decade.

items.title: The 'debasement trade' returns after Bessent bond maneuver. Crypto and gold are back in style
items.summary: Concern over the size and the cost of U.S. government spending has given new life to the debasement trade.

items.title: A massive trade just happened in gold. The options market is buzzing
items.summary: Twenty minutes after the market opened Monday, someone took profit on a $200 million GLD position
